resolvedAdvisories.title: extract-zip unvalidated symlink path traversal
resolvedAdvisories.reachability: Reached only through puppeteer-core 24.43.1 (pinned by lighthouse 12.6.1) when it unpacks a browser archive; exploiting it needs a malicious zip, and CI does not feed it archives other than official browser downloads.
